competencies.name: Gathers and interprets clinical information systematically
competencies.description: Uses a structured approach to collect, prioritise and interpret information about a person's condition.
learningOutcomes: Applies a structured assessment approach (for example A to E)
Distinguishes normal from abnormal findings and explains their significance

competencies.name: Recognises and responds to deterioration
competencies.description: Identifies early warning signs and acts within scope and escalation policy.
learningOutcomes: Explains early warning signs and their thresholds
Escalates using a structured handover (for example SBAR)

competencies.name: Verifies identity and consent before care
competencies.description: Confirms the right person, procedure and consent before any intervention.
learningOutcomes: Uses two identifiers before every intervention
Explains when and how consent is obtained and documented

competencies.name: Recognises, reports and learns from incidents
competencies.description: Applies a just-culture approach to error and near miss.
learningOutcomes: Reports an incident through the local system
Describes how learning is shared after an incident

competencies.name: Communicates clearly with people and families
competencies.description: Adapts information to the person's needs, language and health literacy.

competencies.name: Hands over care safely
competencies.description: Gives and receives structured handover between people and teams.
learningOutcomes: Confirms actions and responsibilities at handover

competencies.name: Performs hand hygiene at the right moments
competencies.description: Applies the five moments of hand hygiene.
learningOutcomes: Names and applies the five moments
Performs hand hygiene to the recommended technique

competencies.name: Uses personal protective equipment correctly
competencies.description: Selects, dons and doffs PPE for the precautions required.
learningOutcomes: Selects PPE for standard and transmission-based precautions
Dons and doffs in the correct sequence
